name: Nacho's PR Inbox
summary: PR Inbox with on-demand CI failure evidence, bounded history and reviewed agent investigation briefs.

command: query=query($owner:String!,$name:String!){repository(owner:$owner,name:$name){nameWithOwner pullRequests(states:OPEN,first:50,orderBy:{field:UPDATED_AT,direction:DESC}){nodes{number title url isDraft author{login} headRefName headRefOid headRepository{nameWithOwner} baseRefName baseRefOid updatedAt reviewDecision mergeable commits(last:1){nodes{commit{statusCheckRollup{state contexts{totalCount checkRunCountsByState{state count} statusContextCountsByState{state count}}}}}} reactions(content:THUMBS_UP,first:50){nodes{user{login}}} eyes:reactions(content:EYES,first:50){nodes{user{login}}}}} merged:pullRequests(states:MERGED,first:50,orderBy:{field:UPDATED_AT,direction:DESC}){nodes{number title url author{login} headRefName mergedAt}}}}
